build: cargo build -p casars-simulation --bin simobserve; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0; rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28)
host: bg-mac-mini, macOS arm64; debug binary with the task default backend setting
command: CASAPY tools/simulation/simobserve_parity.py --out target/1053-model-coverage --casars-bin TARGET/debug/simobserve --casatestdata LOCAL_COPY --only model_direction model_cell model_direction_cell components_cube frame_topo coarse_cell
inputs: casatestdata unittest/simobserve/core5ps.skymodel, core5ps.clist and flatone.model; ALMA alma.out01.cfg from the installed CASA data repository
time_alignment: casars_params uses CASA measures at the reference epoch to compensate the approved TAI-labelled-UTC difference, comparing equal stored TIME.

comparator.products: same non-graphics product names; pointing files byte-identical
comparator.images: same shape/unit; coordinate reference values, reference pixels and increments rtol 1e-12, atol 0; finite pixels max absolute difference <= 1e-6 of CASA peak
comparator.measurement_sets: compare_sm_ms.py compares descriptors, keywords, subtables, cells and flags with its unchanged per-column tolerances and existing known differences; DATA NRMS <= 1e-3; UVW <= 1e-3 m
comparator.frequency_frames: same SPECTRAL_WINDOW reference code and channel frequencies (rtol 0, atol 1e-3 Hz)
comparator.outcome: all cases must succeed except coarse_cell, which must match CASA refusal and remaining products

limits: This is bounded correctness evidence for scalar direction/cell overrides and a four-channel component-only model. No graphics, exhaustive model combinations, noise or full-programme performance/memory acceptance is claimed. Debug timings are recorded only as run diagnostics.
